disease_state: It was the aim of this study to corroborate the content of products for diagnosis and treatment of dust mite allergies that are produced and sold in India.
material_type: inferred: 4 products contained allergens from the storage mite Suidasia medanensis, allergens from the legume Cicer arietinum (chickpea), and proteins from baker's yeast.
sample_source: All samples were purchased by collaborating physicians in India from local vendors and shipped to Europe under temperature-controlled conditions at 4 °C.
species: From the 5 Indian Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus products, none contained proteins from this source.
